Title: Anonymous visitor to /dashboard is sent to login with a redirect back
Steps: 1. Open /dashboard
Expected Result: Redirected to /login?redirect=%2Fdashboard and the login heading shows

Title: Valid credentials log in and land on the dashboard
Steps: 1. Open /login 2. Enter email and password 3. Click Log in
Expected Result: URL is /dashboard and the dashboard heading shows

Title: Wrong password shows a friendly error and stays on login
Steps: 1. Enter the right email with a wrong password 2. Click Log in
Expected Result: Alert reads 'That email and password don't match an account.' and URL stays on /login

Title: Empty or malformed login fields are rejected before any request
Steps: 1. Click Log in with empty fields 2. Enter 'notanemail' and click Log in 3. Enter a valid email with no password and click Log in
Expected Result: Alerts read 'Enter a valid email', 'Enter a valid email', then 'Enter your password'

Title: Sign-up with a new email asks the couple to confirm before login
Preconditions: E2E_SEND_SIGNUP_EMAIL=1 set (sends a real email, rate-limited by Supabase)
Steps: 1. Open /login?mode=signup 2. Fill name, new email, password 3. Click Create account
Expected Result: 'Check your inbox' panel shows with the email address
Notes: Opt-in: set E2E_SEND_SIGNUP_EMAIL=1 (sends a real email; Supabase rate-limits these)

Title: Sign-up with an existing email is refused and points to login
Steps: 1. Open /login?mode=signup 2. Enter the existing email and a password 3. Click Create account
Expected Result: Alert reads 'An account already exists for this email. Log in instead.'

Title: Sign-up rejects a missing name and a short password without calling Supabase
Steps: 1. Open sign-up, leave name empty, submit 2. Enter a name and a password under 8 characters, submit
Expected Result: Alerts read 'Tell us your name' then 'Use at least 8 characters'

Title: Invalid or already-used email link lands on login with an explanation
Steps: 1. Open /auth/callback?next=/dashboard with no code
Expected Result: Redirected to /login?error=link with the 'invalid or has already been used' message

Title: Post-login redirect cannot leave the site (open-redirect guard)
Steps: 1. Open /login?redirect=//evil.example.com 2. Log in
Expected Result: Lands on the dashboard on this site, not on the external host

Title: Signing out ends the session and blocks the dashboard again
Steps: 1. Open the account menu 2. Click Sign out 3. Open /dashboard
Expected Result: Signed out; /dashboard redirects to login

Title: Demo account logs in from the login form
Preconditions: Demo account exists in Supabase with a confirmed email
Steps: 1. Open /login 2. Enter demo@selahvie.com / demo1234 3. Click Log in
Expected Result: Lands on the dashboard
Notes: Environment: demo account email is unconfirmed in Supabase, so login returns Confirm your email first""

Title: Checkout refuses anonymous callers
Steps: 1. POST /api/checkout with a valid body and no session
Expected Result: 401 with 'Please log in to complete your purchase.'

Title: Checkout rejects an unknown payment method, an empty cart and more than 20 items
Steps: 1. POST with method 'bitcoin' 2. POST with empty items 3. POST with 21 items
Expected Result: Each returns 400 'Invalid order.'

Title: Checkout refuses a template that no longer exists
Steps: 1. POST with templateId 'does-not-exist'
Expected Result: 400 with 'One of the templates in your cart no longer exists.'

Title: Server recomputes the price; client-sent amounts are ignored
Steps: 1. POST a Monochrome essential item with price: 1 and unit_price_cents: 1 2. Read orders.total_cents in the database
Expected Result: Stored total is 9900 (base price), status 'paid'

Title: Premium purchase includes the Premium add-on
Steps: 1. POST a Jewel Tones premium item 2. Read the order total and the website tier
Expected Result: Total is 92900 (12900 + 80000); website tier is 'premium' and owner is the buyer

Title: An upgrade cannot be bought for a website owned by someone else (IDOR)
Preconditions: Two accounts; account A owns a website
Steps: 1. Account A buys a website 2. Account B POSTs an upgrade for that website id
Expected Result: 403 'One of the websites in your cart isn't yours.' and the website tier is unchanged

Title: Upgrading to a package the website already has is refused without charging
Preconditions: Logged in; a Premium website owned
Steps: 1. POST an upgrade item to premium for that website
Expected Result: 409 'Everything in your cart is already unlocked.'

Title: A draft website is hidden from visitors and fully visible to its owner
Preconditions: Logged in; website is a draft
Steps: 1. GET /api/sites/{id} with no session 2. GET with the owner's session
Expected Result: Visitor gets 404; owner gets 200 with isOwner true and a guests array

Title: Unknown website id returns 404 rather than an error
Steps: 1. GET /api/sites/{random uuid}
Expected Result: 404 with 'Not found.'

Title: Only the demo account can seed demo websites
Preconditions: Logged in as a non-demo account
Steps: 1. POST /api/demo/seed
Expected Result: 403 with 'Not allowed.'

Title: Photo uploads require a signed-in couple
Steps: 1. POST /api/uploads with a PNG
Expected Result: 401 'Please log in to upload photos.'

Title: Uploads reject non-images and oversize files, and only write into the couple's own website
Steps: 1. POST an HTML file as image 2. POST a 6 MB PNG 3. POST with another website's scope
Expected Result: 415 for HTML, 413 for 6 MB, and 400 or 403 for the foreign scope

Title: Text invitations are refused on Classic and lower
Steps: 1. GET /api/sms/invitations?weddingId={id}
Expected Result: 403 'Text invitations come with the Premium plan.'

Title: Text invitations need a signed-in owner
Steps: 1. GET /api/sms/invitations?weddingId={random uuid}

Title: Premium owner can open text invitations
Preconditions: Logged in; Premium website owned; sms_invitations table present
Steps: 1. GET /api/sms/invitations?weddingId={id}
Expected Result: 200 with the SMS status payload
Notes: Previously flagged as blocked; the app queries sms_messages (present), not sms_invitations

Title: Couple buys a template, pays with GCash and sees it on the dashboard
Steps: 1. Open /templates/t13 2. Add to cart 3. Open /checkout 4. Enter an 11-digit mobile 5. Pay
Expected Result: Success page shows; dashboard lists 'Monochrome' and '1 website'

Title: Card payment with an invalid card number is blocked before any charge
Steps: 1. Choose Card 2. Enter a 9-digit card number, a valid expiry and CVC 3. Pay
Expected Result: 'Enter a valid 16-digit card number' shows; URL stays on /checkout

Title: Checkout requires a full name
Steps: 1. Clear Full name 2. Enter a mobile number 3. Pay
Expected Result: 'Full name is required' shows

Title: Empty cart explains itself and offers the templates
Steps: 1. Open /checkout
Expected Result: 'Your cart is empty' with a Browse templates link

Title: Cart survives a page reload
Steps: 1. Add to cart 2. Reload
Expected Result: Cart still shows 'View in cart'

Title: Essential website upgrades to Premium for the difference only
Steps: 1. Open /dashboard/manage/{id}?tab=share 2. Click 'Upgrade for ₱800' 3. Pay on checkout
Expected Result: Checkout shows 'Premium upgrade' and ₱800.00; success mentions the upgrade; tier becomes premium

Title: Stale cart with a removed template fails on the server and charges nothing
Preconditions: Logged in; localStorage cart holds a retired template id
Steps: 1. Open /checkout 2. Pay
Expected Result: Error 'One of the templates in your cart no longer exists.' shows; no order is created

Title: Publishing makes the site public; it stays hidden until then
Steps: 1. Anonymous GET /api/sites/{id} 2. Open customize, Publish website 3. Anonymous GET /api/sites/{slug}
Expected Result: Draft: 404. After publish: redirected to /wedding/{slug}, anonymous GET 200 with isOwner false, status 'published' in the database

Title: A change to the couple's names is saved and survives a reload
Steps: 1. Open customize at step couple 2. Enter Partner 1 name 3. Wait for save 4. Reload
Expected Result: Database row partner1_name updates; the field keeps the value after reload

Title: Essential website shows Premium features as locked with the price of the difference
Steps: 1. Open manage at tab share
Expected Result: 'Upgrade for ₱800' button visible

Title: A guest added on the guest list is saved and counted
Steps: 1. Open manage at tab guests 2. Add guest with name and email 3. Save
Expected Result: Guest shows in the list and exists in the guests table

Title: A CSV import with a Name column adds every row
Steps: 1. Upload a CSV with two rows via the import input
Expected Result: 'Imported 2 guests' shows; two guest rows exist

Title: Owner texts guests their invitation links (Premium)
Preconditions: Premium website published; UNISMS keys set; sms tables present
Steps: 1. Open manage at tab guests 2. Choose guests 3. Send text
Expected Result: Texts are reserved and logged in sms_messages; status shown per guest
Notes: Needs UniSMS keys in .env.local and a published Premium site

Title: Text sending is refused before the website is published
Steps: 1. POST /api/sms/invitations
Expected Result: 409 'Publish your website first, so the links in your texts open.'

Title: Text message containing a web address is refused
Steps: 1. POST a message containing 'https://'
Expected Result: 400 'Leave web addresses out of your message.'

Title: Guest submits an RSVP on the published site and the owner sees it
Steps: 1. Open the public site 2. Fill the RSVP form 3. Submit 4. Open the owner's RSVPs tab
Expected Result: Confirmation shows; RSVP appears in the owner's dashboard and guest status updates

Title: Invite code that does not match shows the 'not found' prompt
Preconditions: Published Premium website with a guest list
Steps: 1. Open /wedding/{slug}?invite=WRONG
Expected Result: The find-invitation prompt shows the code was not recognised

Title: Demo and preview renders never write real RSVPs
Steps: 1. Submit an RSVP on a demo site
Expected Result: Confirmation shows; no row written to rsvps

Title: Demo account gets sample websites the first time it logs in
Preconditions: Demo account exists and has no websites
Steps: 1. Log in as demo
Expected Result: Dashboard lists the sample websites
Notes: Demo account email unconfirmed in Supabase

Title: Uploading a JPEG from the couple's editor stores it and shows it
Steps: 1. Use a photo field in customize 2. Pick a JPEG
Expected Result: Photo previews and the URL persists after reload

Title: Templates page lists templates and filters by tag
Steps: 1. Open /templates 2. Click a tag chip
Expected Result: Grid updates to matching templates

Title: Template sort options reorder the grid
Steps: 1. Open /templates 2. Choose Price: Low to High
Expected Result: Prices ascend

Title: Removing an item from the cart updates the total
Steps: 1. Open cart 2. Remove one item
Expected Result: Total updates; item is gone

Title: Unknown route shows a 404 page
Steps: 1. Open /no-such-page
Expected Result: Not-found page renders with a way back

Title: Public nav links reach About and Templates
Steps: 1. Click About Us, then Templates
Expected Result: Each page loads with its heading

Title: Manage tabs support arrow keys and Home/End (roving focus)
Steps: 1. Focus the first tab 2. Press ArrowRight, End, Home
Expected Result: Focus and selected tab move as the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern describes

Title: Auth form errors are announced to screen readers
Steps: 1. Submit empty login
Expected Result: Error is in a role=alert element

Title: Login and dashboard usable at a 375px mobile width
Steps: 1. Set viewport 375x812 2. Open /login and /dashboard
Expected Result: No horizontal scroll; primary actions reachable
